checks: All source lines statically read. Primary native qualification must already PASS at exact commit/tree and same qualified binary.
Derived executable is exactly original bytes plus fixed trailing marker. ELF64 headers, entry, all program headers and PT_LOAD segment bytes remain equal; whole-file SHA changes.
Driver hashes actual /proc/ownedpid/exe, not just the expected pathname; file identity is checked before and after reading.
Only own process groups are stopped/killed; original checkpoint and qualified executable are never modified.
Before changed process start the original same-boot window has >20s on both clocks; before recover >15s; after recover both remain live. Expiry/reboot are excluded as explanations.

Before recovery no Restored charge exists and all phase files equal publication-time evidence; exact saved-executable drift error, zero new forwards/compilers, no fresh qualification and full original-function inverse are required.
All phase charge/result files and immutable original intent remain unchanged. Second recovery must be effect-identical and perform no work.
Exact successful call count is 2 servers, 9 wire RPCs, 5 tool calls, 1 roundtrip/intent/kill and 2 recoveries; source-bound forward upper bound is five.
limitations: Static review, no new server/model/grader/optimizer/test execution.
Control changes whole-file identity while preserving loaded code; it does not establish arbitrary upgrade compatibility or qualify a new executable.
Partial work is covered by a source upper bound; no exact interrupted-forward total is claimed.
The original cold-recovery race window must be observed, not retried if missed.
